label: evidence-help
stdout:
usage: harnessctl evidence [-h] --artifact ARTIFACT --checkpoint
                           {start,pre-action,transition,handoff}
                           [--rebound-at REBOUND_AT] [--json]
                           [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --artifact ARTIFACT   the work order the packet is keyed by
  --checkpoint {start,pre-action,transition,handoff}
  --rebound-at REBOUND_AT
                        RFC 3339 UTC timestamp to record; defaults to now
  --json                emit se-harness-workflow-result-v2 JSON
